subject: Pilot billing cadence & provisional credit for HelixMed POC
messages:
From: Liam O'Riley <liam@helixmed.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: billing@helixmed.com
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot billing cadence & credit for HelixMed POC

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to run the 2-month POC with the Redwood runtime. Before we kick off, procurement asked me to confirm a few billing items so we can route the PO:

- Requested net terms: Net60 for the pilot (billing team prefers 60 days for new vendor pilots)
- Estimated spend for pilot: $58k (monthly usage ramping, total expected $116k over 2 months)
- We will issue a PO (attached) and need an e-invoice endpoint (we publish invoices into our AP system)
- VAT: HelixMed is a UK entity; we will send VAT certificate but need confirmation on how you handle EU VAT on invoices

Can Redwood provide a provisional credit cap and any onboarding holdback requirements? Also — will you accept electronic invoices (UBL/XML/PEPPOL) or only PDFs?

Attached: HelixMed_PO-987.pdf

Best,
Liam
Head of Platform Integrations, HelixMed
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Pilot billing cadence & credit for HelixMed POC

Folks — forwarding HelixMed's ask. Key asks: Net60 for initial pilot, e-invoice support, VAT cert submission, and PO attached.

My suggested approach (to keep deal moving while protecting AR):
- Offer provisional credit cap of $50,000 to allow the pilot to start.
- Billing cadence: invoice monthly in arrears. For month 1, invoice Net45; for month 2, Net45 — then review for production terms. (This compromises between Net60 request and our default)
- Require SOC2 evidence + VAT certificate before finalizing credit release.
- If Finance prefers, add a 20% holdback on the first invoice payable upon completion of the pilot acceptance criteria.
- Accept e-invoice: we support a simple XML ingest (product/billing will need the field mapping). Suggest attaching a minimal eInvoice field map and looping in billing integration owner.

Next steps: Marissa, can you confirm the provisional credit cap and whether Finance needs partial prepay instead? Karthik, if you agree, I'll send a short conditional SOW and DocuSign link to Liam that outlines Net45 x2 with a $50k provisional cap and SOC2/VAT gating.

Thanks — Tessa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Pilot billing cadence & credit for HelixMed POC

Tessa —

Finance constraints: we generally avoid Net60 for new customers without credit history. Options I can support:

1) Provisional credit cap of $50k (as you suggested) with Net45 terms for the first two invoices. Require SOC2 summary and VAT certificate prior to issuing the second invoice.

2) If HelixMed insists on Net60, we can accept Net60 but require a 25% prepayment or a 30% credit holdback on first invoice.

3) For e-invoice ingest: we need the field map and an endpoint (SFTP or HTTPS POST). Attach a short SOC2 summary I can circulate to compliance.

If we go with #1 I will clear the $50k provisional in our system and set up an AR flag to auto-block past-due beyond 60 days. Please confirm whether we should include a 1.5% early-pay discount for Net30 as an incentive — we typically use that successfully.

Attachment: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

-Marissa
Director, Finance, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Pilot billing cadence & credit for HelixMed POC

Agree with Marissa. Operationally we can provision $50k provisional credit and set the billing to Net45 x2 with the SOC2 + VAT gating.

I'll offer the customer a 1.5% early-pay discount if they sign Net30; otherwise proceed with the Net45 conditional SOW. Product billing team will need the eInvoice field mapping — attaching our minimal mapping template (I'll drop it into the deal record).

Please go ahead, Tessa, to send the conditional SOW and DocuSign link. I'll update HubSpot with provisional credit flag: deal HD-4219.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales Ops
From: Liam O'Riley <liam@helixmed.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: billing@helixmed.com, purchasing@helixmed.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot billing cadence & credit for HelixMed POC

Hi Tessa — thanks for coordinating with Finance. HelixMed is happy to proceed on the conditional terms you outlined:

- Accept provisional credit cap: $50,000
- Billing cadence: Net45 for month 1 and month 2 invoices (we can target Net30 if we take the early-pay 1.5% discount — will confirm internally)
- We'll upload our VAT certificate and return the signed conditional SOW via DocuSign. Please send the DocuSign link and e-invoice endpoint details (we prefer HTTPS POST API).

Attached: HelixMed_VAT-certificate.pdf

One operational note: our AP team needs the XML field mapping for invoice ingestion and one test invoice in the sandbox. Karthik/Marissa — if you can share the mapping and sandbox endpoint, we'll configure our system this week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Liam
